what: A strip of cards overflowing horizontally starts centered, and when you move the cursor left and right over the panel the strip is pushed the opposite way by the same amount (.4s power3). The remaining overflow is divided over the remaining screen width from the point of entry, so when the cursor reaches the panel edge the strip reaches its last card. The cards split into three groups (assigned in rotation) that lag behind by the distance pushed and follow with elastic at 1, 1.3 and 1.6s, while three random groups also tilt by the pushed distance ÷ 10 and settle at 2, 1.7 and 1.4s. When the cursor stops, everything bounces back into place after .12s. On touch, the strip is simply pushed by the finger.
note: Card gap is --fx-gap (default 16px). On touch devices or with reduced motion it stays as a horizontal scroll band

from.where: index.html .bw-strip (three platform template rows and a text row). Original MwgEffect055: quickTo x .4 power3, group x elastic [1,1.3,1.6], rotation elastic [2,1.7,1.4] (distance/10), back to 0 after 120ms.
